dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000q5ps](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000q5ps) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 7.673 depth occurred on Apr 13 2025 3km SW of Phayasu. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 21.1538 longitude 96.0055. It impacted 821425 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
